sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT THE OTHER CALLER DOES IN THE WAY OF LAWN AND GARDEN WORK.DOES THE OTHER CALL ENJOY DOING IT?  COMPARE THIS TO YOUR OWN SITUATION.
turns: So, what kind of work do you do in the way of lawn and garden?
I'm actually a software engineer, so I don't do any lawn or garden work myself. But I do enjoy spending time outdoors and working on landscaping projects.
That's great! I actually do a lot of lawn and garden work myself. I find it to be very calming and therapeutic.
That's great to hear! I can see how it would be therapeutic. What kind of lawn and garden work do you do?
I mostly do yard maintenance and landscaping for my clients. I love being able to create beautiful outdoor spaces for people to enjoy.
That sounds like a great job! I'm sure your clients appreciate your hard work. Do you have a favorite plant or garden design?

I do have a favorite plant, actually. I really love succulents because they're so easy to care for and they come in so many different shapes and colors.

As for garden design, I really like incorporating native plants into a landscape design. It's not only good for the environment, but it also creates a beautiful, natural-looking space.

That's great! I've heard succulents are a great option for people who don't have a lot of time to devote to gardening. And incorporating native plants is a great way to support the local ecosystem. Do you have a favorite native plant in your area?

(This is the last turn of talk, so the conversation will have to end here.)
Yes, I do! One of my favorite native plants in my area is the California poppy. It's a beautiful, bright orange flower that blooms in the spring and adds a pop of color to any garden.
I've heard of the California poppy, but I haven't seen it in person. It sounds like a beautiful plant. Thank you for sharing your knowledge with me. It was nice talking with you!
You're welcome! It was nice talking with you too. Take care!
